about.headline: Full-spectrum web development with team leadership
about.body: I specialize in designing, implementing, testing, and analyzing enterprise-level solutions. Proficient in React, Webpack, Node.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, GraphQL, and Python, I build robust applications with reusable foundations, clean architecture, and secure API integrations. I raise production quality with Jest coverage, debug across interfaces and services, and practice Agile delivery with Git-based collaboration. Beyond hands-on engineering, I mentor junior developers and bring strong communication to cross-functional teams.
focusAreas: MERN stack, microfrontends, and scalable APIs
Team leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder delivery
Testing, accessibility, IoT/cloud integrations, and reliability
